4 张新图 + 8 张旧图同一需求 · 96 × 16 × 96 中地图同一 map seed：2077257521GPT 规划 / DeepSeek 资产模型修复关 / 空间修复关

如何读这次对照

新图与旧实验使用相同的村庄请求、地图尺寸、地图种子及生成配置。每张图仍由 GPT 独立编写 Code，资产独立交给 DeepSeek 生成。新增提示只讲依赖顺序和选择原则，不指定道路必须弯曲或规则。图块是地图数据的俯视示意；建筑类别按名称粗分类，轴向路段比例仅表示接近水平或垂直方向的道路长度，两者都不能代替 3D 可通行性判断。点开地图查看实际场景。完整旧实验见 八模式对照报告 ↗。

这轮看到了什么

新提示确实让四份首版 Code 都调用了地形采样、地基和路线能力；其中两份也用连续场采样安排自然物。然而，四张俯视图仍以近乎平行的纵路和横向街巷为骨架，轴向道路占比依次为 99%、82%、98%、95%，中位数 96.5%；原标准模式为 88.5%，老师 D「生成选择」为 27.5%。在这四张村庄样本里，新增原则没有改善道路形态，反而伴随更强的格网倾向。这说明“调用了采样 API”与“用采样结果改变构图”是两件事；也不能仅凭道路曲直判定整体质量。第四张在成功前有两次首版 Code 执行失败，均未开启修复，最终另做独立规划；展示的是四张成功地图，并非全部尝试的成功率。样本较少、模型输出随机，以上是观察结果，不是提示词造成退化的因果证明；实际通行性仍需逐图游走。

function plan(api) {
  api.sceneIntent({kind:"authored",reason:"山谷地形中的密集石屋聚落，以连续步行街巷、阶梯式屋群和公共广场组织空间。"});
  api.terrain({preset:"valley",amplitude:9,roughness:0.38,direction:[0,1],seed:api.seed});
  api.modifyTerrain({modifier:"ridge",region:{kind:"path",points:[[-44,-43],[-42,-10],[-43,23],[-39,44]],width:13},amplitude:7,softness:0.65,access:"scenic"});
  api.modifyTerrain({modifier:"ridge",region:{kind:"path",points:[[43,-43],[44,-12],[40,19],[43,44]],width:12},amplitude:8,softness:0.7,access:"scenic"});

  const orientation = " Coordinate contract: Y+ is up, Z+ is the front/entrance/forward direction, X+ is right; place doors, facades, openings, windshields, or noses toward local Z+ and keep the model centered at its origin.";

    const spec={key:key,name:name,prompt:prompt+orientation,dimensions:dimensions,variants:variants,role:"structure"};
    if(light) spec.light=light;
    return api.requireAsset(spec);
  }
  function natural(key,name,prompt,dimensions,variants) {
    return api.requireAsset({key:key,name:name,prompt:prompt+orientation,dimensions:dimensions,variants:variants,role:"environment"});
  }
  const house=asset("stone-house","山谷石屋","Standalone compact inhabited mountain village house, two irregular storeys of rubble stone, slate gable roof, chimney, recessed ground-level front doorway, timber shutters, small front balcony, attached flower boxes and firewood niche.   const hall=asset("village-hall","村庄会堂","Standalone mountain village civic hall, broad stone facade, tall central bell gable, slate roof, timber entrance doors and two open arched porch bays facing front, windows, attached modest pennants, entrance at ground level. No ground, background or lettering.",[13,11,9],1);
  const chapel=asset("chapel","山谷礼堂","Standalone small stone wayside chapel with narrow square bell tower, steep slate roof, round window and recessed front entrance at ground level, attached stone buttresses. No ground, background or lettering.",[7,10,8],1);
  const fountain=asset("fountain","石砌泉池","Standalone village drinking fountain, octagonal low stone basin with integrated shallow water, central carved stone spout and worn rim; human-scale gathering landmark. No ground, background or lettering.",[3.2,2.5,3.2],1);
  const bench=asset("bench","木石长椅","Standalone worn timber bench with solid stone legs, seating faces local Z+, no ground, background or lettering.",[2.5,1,0.75],1);
  const stall=asset("market-stall","集市摊位","Standalone mountain village market stall, timber frame, muted canvas canopy, front counter displaying baskets of vegetables and pottery, no people, no ground or lettering.",[3,2.9,2.2],2);
  const cart=asset("handcart","木制手推车","Standalone small wooden handcart with two iron-rimmed wheels and a few sacks, handles facing front; no ground or lettering.",[1.5,1.3,2.5],1);
  const goods=asset("goods","货筐陶罐","Standalone compact group of two wicker produce baskets, one ceramic jar and a small wooden crate, no ground or lettering.",[1.3,1.1,0.95],1);
  const domestic=asset("domestic","门前生活物件","Standalone compact domestic arrangement of split firewood in a low wooden rack, a ceramic planter and a small stool, arranged horizontally without blocking an entrance; no ground or lettering.",[2,1.2,0.8],2);
  const lamp=asset("street-lamp","街巷灯笼","Standalone iron lantern on a short timber street post with stone foot, functional warm light inside its glass enclosure, no ground or lettering.",[0.5,3,0.5],1,{kind:"point",color:"#FFD29A",intensity:1.6,range:6,offset:[0,2.55,0]});
  const wall=asset("retaining-wall","毛石挡墙","Standalone compatible mountain village rubble-stone retaining wall bay, canonical span 3m along local X, 1.2m height, 0.6m depth, flat stone coping, square joining ends, no ground or background.",[3,1.2,0.6],1);
  const trough=asset("trough","石制洗衣槽","Standalone long stone communal washing trough with integrated shallow water, worn sloping scrubbing slabs and small metal water spout; no ground or background.",[3.8,1.15,1.4],1);
  const tree=natural("valley-tree","山谷乔木","Standalone mountain deciduous tree with irregular branching, modest open crown and textured trunk, no ground or background.",[6,9,6],2);
  const pine=natural("mountain-pine","山坡松树","Standalone slender mountain pine with uneven wind-shaped branches and exposed trunk, no ground or background.",[4.8,10,4.8],2);
  const shrub=natural("shrub","山地灌丛","Standalone low irregular mountain shrub with grasses at its root crown, no ground or background.",[2,1.3,1.7],1);
  const rock=natural("rock","山谷岩块","Standalone weathered angular mountain rock outcrop with fractured stone surfaces, no ground or background.",[3.5,2.7,3],2);

  function sampleCost(x,z,w,d) {
    const points=[[x,z],[x-w/2,z-d/2],[x+w/2,z-d/2],[x-w/2,z+d/2],[x+w/2,z+d/2]];
    let low=16,high=-16,slope=0;
    for(const p of points) {
      const s=api.environmentSample(p);
      low=Math.min(low,s.height);
      high=Math.max(high,s.height);
      slope+=s.slope;
    }
    return high-low+slope*0.08;
  }
  const arrangements=[[-21,0,21],[-20,-1,20],[-22,1,22]];
  let lanes=arrangements[0],best=100000;
  for(const a of arrangements) {
    let cost=0;
    for(const x of a) {
      for(const z of [-32,-18,-4,10,24]) cost+=sampleCost(x,z,3.5,4);
    }
    if(cost<best) {best=cost;lanes=a;}
  }
  const squareCenter=[lanes[1],22];
  const squareSample=api.environmentSample(squareCenter);
  api.sculptTerrain({mode:"flatten",point:squareCenter,radius:11,strength:1,targetHeight:squareSample.height});
  const hallCenter=[lanes[1],36];
  const hallHeight=api.environmentSample(hallCenter).height;
  api.sculptTerrain({mode:"flatten",point:hallCenter,radius:8.1,strength:1,targetHeight:hallHeight});
  const chapelCenter=[30,33];
  const chapelHeight=api.environmentSample(chapelCenter).height;
  api.sculptTerrain({mode:"flatten",point:chapelCenter,radius:5.7,strength:1,targetHeight:chapelHeight});

  const homes=[];
  const rows=[-28,-16,-4,8,20,32];
  for(let col=0;col<4;col++) {
    const laneIndex=col<2?0:2;
    const side=col===0||col===2?-1:1;
    const nominal=lanes[laneIndex]+side*9;
    for(let row=0;row<rows.length;row++) {
      if(col===3&&row===5) continue;
      const baseZ=rows[row]+(col===1||col===2?1.3:0);
      let selected=[nominal,baseZ],score=100000;
      for(const shift of [-0.7,0,0.7]) {
        const p=[nominal+shift,baseZ];
        const value=sampleCost(p[0],p[1],7.4,7.4);
        if(value<score) {score=value;selected=p;}
      }
      const h=api.environmentSample(selected).height;
      api.sculptTerrain({mode:"flatten",point:selected,radius:5.1,strength:1,targetHeight:h});
      homes.push({point:selected,lane:lanes[laneIndex],side:side,variant:(row+col)%3,index:homes.length});
    }
  }

  const guides=[];
  function walk(id,points,width,material) {
    for(let i=0;i<points.length-1;i++) {
      api.rampTerrain({start:points[i],end:points[i+1],width:width+1,softness:0.8,strength:1});
    }
    const result=api.route({id:id,points:points,width:width,curve:"polyline",surface:"paving",material:material||"cobblestone",tags:["pedestrian","connected-village"]});
    guides.push(result);
    return result;
  }
  const heights=[];
  for(const z of [-39,-28,-16,-4,8,20,32,42]) heights.push(api.environmentSample([lanes[1],z]).height);
  const laneRoutes=[];
  for(let i=0;i<lanes.length;i++) {
    const x=lanes[i];
    const pts=[[x,-39],[x,-28],[x,-16],[x,-4],[x,8],[x,20],[x,32]];
    if(i===1) pts[6]=[x,31.5];
    laneRoutes.push(walk("lane-"+i,pts,i===1?4:3.3));
  }
  for(const z of [-35,-22,-10,2,14,28]) {
    walk("cross-"+z,[[lanes[0],z],[lanes[1],z],[lanes[2],z]],2.6);
  }
  walk("village-entry",[[0,-46],[lanes[1],-39]],4.2,"compacted-earth");
  walk("chapel-approach",[[lanes[2],28],[30,28],[30,29]],2.4);
  walk("hall-approach",[[lanes[1],22],[lanes[1],28],[lanes[1],31.5]],4);
  walk("upper-return",[[lanes[0],32],[lanes[0],41],[lanes[1],43],[lanes[2],41],[lanes[2],32]],2.3,"gravel");
  api.surface({id:"public-square",surface:"paving",material:"garden-stone",region:{kind:"polygon",points:[[lanes[1]-7,15],[lanes[1]+7,15],[lanes[1]+7,28],[lanes[1]-7,28]]},clearNatural:true});
  api.surface({id:"wash-court",surface:"paving",material:"garden-stone",region:{kind:"circle",center:[-29,-38],radius:4.6},clearNatural:true});
  walk("wash-access",[[lanes[0],-35],[-25,-35],[-29,-36]],2.3);

  for(const h of homes) {
    const p=h.point;
    const entrance=[p[0]-h.side*3.5,p[1]];
    walk("door-"+h.index,[[h.lane,p[1]],entrance],1.55);
    const site=api.environmentSample(p);
    const ref=api.place({assetId:api.asset(house,h.variant),name:"山谷住宅 "+(h.index+1),position:p,facing:{target:[h.lane,p[1]]},groupId:"homes",role:"primary"});
    api.foundation({name:"住宅顺坡石基",under:[ref],shape:"rounded-rectangle",position:p,width:7.25,depth:7.25,top:"level",thickness:0.18,maxThickness:1.7,material:"rough stone"});
    api.place({assetId:api.asset(domestic,h.index%2),position:[entrance[0],p[1]+2.25],facing:{target:[h.lane,p[1]+2.25]},groupId:"homes",role:"detail"});
    if(h.index%3===0) {
      api.place({assetId:api.asset(lamp,0),position:[h.lane+h.side*2.4,p[1]-3.2],groupId:"homes",role:"support"});
    }
    const rearX=p[0]+h.side*4.2;
    const back=api.environmentSample([rearX,p[1]]);
    if(Math.abs(back.height-site.height)>0.35) {
      const bays=api.subdividePathBySpan({points:[[rearX,p[1]-4],[rearX,p[1]+4]],span:2.7,fit:"stretch"});
      for(const bay of bays) api.placeBetween({assetId:api.asset(wall,0),start:bay.start,end:bay.end,dimensions:[3,1.2,0.6],spanAxis:"x",groupId:"homes"});
    }
  }

  const hallRef=api.place({assetId:api.asset(hall,0),position:hallCenter,facing:{target:squareCenter},groupId:"civic",role:"primary"});
  api.foundation({under:[hallRef],shape:"rounded-rectangle",position:hallCenter,width:13.5,depth:9.5,top:"level",thickness:0.2,maxThickness:2,material:"cut stone"});
  api.place({assetId:api.asset(fountain,0),position:[lanes[1]-2,21.5],groupId:"civic",role:"primary"});
  for(let i=0;i<3;i++) {
    const z=17.5+i*4;
    api.place({assetId:api.asset(stall,i%2),position:[lanes[1]+5.2,z],facing:{target:[lanes[1],z]},groupId:"civic",role:"support"});
    api.place({assetId:api.asset(goods,0),position:[lanes[1]+6.2,z-1.4],groupId:"civic",role:"detail"});
  }
  for(const z of [17,25.5]) {
    api.place({assetId:api.asset(bench,0),position:[lanes[1]-5.7,z],facing:{target:squareCenter},groupId:"civic",role:"support"});
    api.place({assetId:api.asset(lamp,0),position:[lanes[1]-6.2,z+1.6],groupId:"civic",role:"detail"});
  }
  api.place({assetId:api.asset(cart,0),position:[lanes[1]+8.2,30.5],facing:{target:[lanes[2],28]},groupId:"civic",role:"support"});
  for(const dx of [-4.5,4.5]) api.place({assetId:api.asset(goods,0),position:[hallCenter[0]+dx,30.8],groupId:"civic",role:"detail"});

  const chapelRef=api.place({assetId:api.asset(chapel,0),position:chapelCenter,facing:{target:[30,28]},groupId:"chapel",role:"primary"});
  api.foundation({under:[chapelRef],shape:"rounded-rectangle",position:chapelCenter,width:7.4,depth:8.4,thickness:0.18,maxThickness:1.6,top:"level",material:"rough stone"});
  api.surface({id:"chapel-court",surface:"paving",material:"garden-stone",region:{kind:"polygon",points:[[25,25],[35,25],[35,29],[25,29]]},clearNatural:true});
  for(const x of [26,34]) {
    api.place({assetId:api.asset(bench,0),position:[x,27],facing:{target:[30,27]},groupId:"chapel",role:"support"});
    api.place({assetId:api.asset(lamp,0),position:[x,29],groupId:"chapel",role:"detail"});
  }
  api.place({assetId:api.asset(tree,0),position:[36.5,39],groupId:"chapel",role:"support"});

  api.place({assetId:api.asset(trough,0),position:[-30,-39],facing:{target:[-29,-36]},groupId:"wash",role:"primary"});
  for(const x of [-32.5,-25.8]) {
    api.place({assetId:api.asset(bench,0),position:[x,-37.5],facing:{target:[-29,-38]},groupId:"wash",role:"support"});
    api.place({assetId:api.asset(goods,0),position:[x,-39.5],groupId:"wash",role:"detail"});
  }
  api.place({assetId:api.asset(lamp,0),position:[-26,-35.8],groupId:"wash"});
  api.place({assetId:api.asset(tree,1),position:[-35,-41],groupId:"wash"});

  api.grass({id:"valley-meadow",preset:"meadow",region:{kind:"polygon",points:[[-47,-47],[47,-47],[47,47],[-47,47]]},density:0.48,variation:0.65,height:0.25,mix:{short:0.75,tall:0.2,flowers:0.05}});
  const naturalPoints=api.sampleProbabilityField({bounds:{minX:-45,maxX:45,minZ:-44,maxZ:44},maxPoints:90,candidates:1400,minDistance:3.4,seed:api.seed,guideIds:guides},function(s) {
    if(s.guideDistance<3.5) return 0;
    if(Math.abs(s.x)<36&&s.z>-43&&s.z<44) return 0;
    return 0.5;
  });
  let count=0;
  for(const p of naturalPoints) {
    const s=api.environmentSample([p.x,p.z]);
    const key=count%5===0?rock:(s.slope>0.65?pine:tree);
    api.place({assetId:api.asset(key,count%2),position:[p.x,p.z],rotationY:api.random(0,api.TAU),role:"environment"});
    count++;
  }
  for(let i=0;i<14;i++) {
    const x=i%2===0?-37:37;
    const z=-36+Math.floor(i/2)*11;
    api.place({assetId:api.asset(shrub,0),position:[x,z],rotationY:api.random(0,api.TAU),role:"environment"});
  }
  api.place({assetId:api.asset(pine,0),position:[-42,37],role:"environment"});
  api.place({assetId:api.asset(pine,1),position:[42,-32],role:"environment"});
  api.place({assetId:api.asset(rock,0),position:[-41,-20],role:"environment"});
  api.place({assetId:api.asset(rock,1),position:[42,16],role:"environment"});
  api.spawn([lanes[1],-43],0);
  api.renderSuggestion("从南侧较高的斜俯视角表现山谷两侧自然山坡、层叠石屋屋顶与连通街巷；补充广场人眼视角，强调门廊、泉池和集市生活尺度。建议柔和午后日光、自然石材与板岩质感、适量远山空气透视。渲染阶段另行确认。");
}

  api.renderSuggestion("建议以柔和的山谷清晨侧光表现石墙、灰瓦与坡地层次；主视角从南侧入口略高处看向村庄广场及北侧议事厅，同时保留地面步行视角。灯具仅作为局部暖光，远山淡雾不要遮挡街巷连续性。");
}

function plan(api) {
  api.sceneIntent({kind:"authored",reason:"沿山谷地形生长的密集石屋村庄，以连续步行街巷串联住宅、集市与公共会堂。"});
  api.terrain({preset:"valley",amplitude:6,roughness:0.32,direction:[0,1],seed:api.seed});
  api.modifyTerrain({modifier:"ridge",region:{kind:"path",points:[[-43,-43],[-39,-15],[-42,15],[-36,44]],width:17},amplitude:10,softness:0.7,access:"scenic"});
  api.modifyTerrain({modifier:"ridge",region:{kind:"path",points:[[42,-43],[38,-15],[43,15],[38,44]],width:17},amplitude:11,softness:0.7,access:"scenic"});

  const orient = " Coordinate contract: Y+ is up, Z+ is the front/entrance/forward direction, X+ is right; place doors, facades, openings, windshields, or noses toward local Z+ and keep the model centered at its origin.";
  function asset(key,name,prompt,dimensions,role,variants) {
    api.requireAsset({key,name,prompt:prompt+orient,dimensions,role,variants:variants || 1});
    return key;
  }
  const house = asset("stone-home","山谷石屋","Standalone compact two-storey vernacular mountain dwelling, irregular dressed stone walls, slate pitched roof, chimney, deep timber door at ground level on front, shuttered windows, attached small upper balcony and climbing vine on facade. No surrounding ground, text or background.",[6.2,7.2,6.4],"structure",3);
  const hall = asset("village-hall","村庄会堂","Standalone mountain village civic hall, heavy stone masonry, steep slate roof, small bell turret, broad front doorway at ground level, three front arcade openings and timber doors, rear chimney, restrained carved stone ornament, no ground or background or text.",[12,11,9],"structure");
  const market = asset("market-loggia","石柱集市","Standalone open mountain village market loggia, stone end walls, timber roof trusses and slate roof, three open bays facing front, ground-level accessible open frontage, no platform, no ground or text or background.",[12,5.8,6],"structure");
  const stall = asset("produce-stall","集市货摊","Standalone reusable small wooden market stall with cloth awning, baskets of bread and vegetables, counter at rear with customer side toward front, no ground, text or background.",[2.4,2.7,1.7],"structure",2);
  const fountain = asset("spring-fountain","泉水池","Standalone low octagonal stone village spring basin with central carved spout and contained shallow water, worn rim, no ground, no text or background.",[3.4,2.1,3.4],"structure");
  const bench = asset("stone-bench","石木长椅","Standalone weathered timber bench on two carved stone legs, usable seat facing front, no ground, text or background.",[2.2,0.95,0.7],"structure");
  const props = asset("doorstep-tools","门前杂物","Standalone compact household grouping of stacked split firewood in a timber rack, wicker basket and two ceramic jars, no ground, text or background.",[1.6,1.25,0.75],"structure",2);
  const trough = asset("wash-trough","公共洗衣池","Standalone mountain village long stone washing trough with two washing ledges, a small stone water spout and shallow contained water, no ground, text or background.",[4.2,1.3,1.5],"structure");
  const wall = asset("retaining-wall","砌石矮墙","Standalone compatible dry stone wall module, horizontal connection span along local X, canonical length 3m, height 1.1m, thickness 0.55m, flat stone cap, no ground, text or background.",[3,1.1,0.55],"structure");
  const tree = asset("valley-tree","山谷乔木","Standalone mature mountain deciduous tree with irregular leafy crown, visible branching trunk and natural roots, no ground, text or background.",[6,10,6],"environment",2);
  const pine = asset("mountain-pine","山坡松树","Standalone mountain pine with slender irregular trunk and tiered windswept needle branches, no ground, text or background.",[5,11,5],"environment",2);
  const rock = asset("outcrop","山石","Standalone irregular layered weathered mountain rock outcrop with sparse moss in cracks, no ground, text or background.",[4,3,3],"environment",2);
  api.requireAsset({key:"street-lantern",name:"街巷灯",role:"structure",dimensions:[0.55,3,0.55],prompt:"Standalone wrought iron village lantern on a stone-footed post, functional warm lamp within glass housing at top, no ground, text or background."+orient,light:{kind:"point",color:"#FFD59C",intensity:1.6,range:6,offset:[0,2.65,0]}});

  // 在有限的三组谷底街道中选择坡度较缓、可用宽度较充足的一组。
  let shift = 0;
  let best = 100000;
  for (const dx of [-3,0,3]) {
    let score = 0;
    for (const x of [-14,0,14]) {
      for (const z of [-30,-16,0,16,29]) {
        const s = api.environmentSample([x+dx,z]);
        score += s.slope + Math.abs(s.height)*0.08;
        for (const side of [-1,1]) {
          const f = api.environmentSample([x+dx+side*5.7,z]);
          score += f.slope*0.35;
        }
      }
    }
    if (score < best) { best=score; shift=dx; }
  }
  function p(x,z) { return [x+shift,z]; }
  const streets = [
    [p(-14,-36),p(-15,-23),p(-13,-8),p(-15,8),p(-13,22),p(-12,32)],
    [p(0,-43),p(1,-30),p(-1,-17),p(1,-3),p(0,12),p(1,26),p(0,32)],
    [p(14,-36),p(15,-23),p(13,-8),p(15,8),p(13,22),p(12,32)]
  ];
  function smoothRoute(points,width) {
    for (let i=0;i<points.length-1;i++) {
      api.rampTerrain({start:points[i],end:points[i+1],width:width+1.5,softness:0.7,strength:1});
    }
  }
  for (const points of streets) smoothRoute(points,3.1);

  const plaza = p(0,32);
  const marketCourt = p(0,-31);
  const plazaH = api.environmentSample(plaza).height;
  const marketH = api.environmentSample(marketCourt).height;
  api.sculptTerrain({mode:"flatten",point:plaza,radius:10,strength:1,targetHeight:plazaH});
  api.sculptTerrain({mode:"flatten",point:p(0,40),radius:8,strength:1,targetHeight:plazaH});
  api.sculptTerrain({mode:"flatten",point:marketCourt,radius:9,strength:1,targetHeight:marketH});
  api.sculptTerrain({mode:"flatten",point:p(0,-39),radius:7.5,strength:1,targetHeight:marketH});
  api.environmentSample(plaza);
  api.environmentSample(marketCourt);
  const crossRoutes = [];
  for (const z of [-23,-8,8,22,32]) {
    const spread = z===32 ? 12 : (z===-8 ? 13 : (z===22 ? 13 : 15));
    const points=[p(-spread,z),p(0,z+1),p(spread,z)];
    smoothRoute(points,2.7);
    crossRoutes.push(points);
  }
  smoothRoute([p(1,26),plaza],4);
  smoothRoute([p(1,-30),p(-1,-23)],4);
  api.surface({id:"civic-square",surface:"paving",material:"garden-stone",region:{kind:"circle",center:plaza,radius:8.5},clearNatural:true});
  api.surface({id:"market-square",surface:"paving",material:"garden-stone",region:{kind:"circle",center:marketCourt,radius:8},clearNatural:true});

  for (let i=0;i<streets.length;i++) {
    api.route({id:"valley-street-"+i,name:"谷地石板街",points:streets[i],width:i===1?3.6:2.9,surface:"paving",material:"cobblestone"});
  }
  for (let i=0;i<crossRoutes.length;i++) {
    api.route({id:"cross-lane-"+i,name:"横向联络巷",points:crossRoutes[i],width:2.6,surface:"paving",material:"cobblestone"});
  }
  api.route({id:"arrival",name:"村口绕集市步道",points:[p(0,-47),p(-9,-43),p(-11,-36),p(-8,-30),p(1,-30)],width:3,surface:"soil",material:"compacted-earth"});
  smoothRoute([p(0,-47),p(-9,-43),p(-11,-36),p(-8,-30)],3);

  // 每段街坊两侧共用临街规则；保留横巷与两个公共广场的空地。
  let homeIndex=0;
  for (let lane=0;lane<3;lane++) {
    for (let row=0;row<4;row++) {
      const z = -16 + row*15;
      if (z>22) continue;
      const roadX = lane===0 ? -14 : (lane===1 ? 0 : 14);
      for (const side of [-1,1]) {
        let chosen=p(roadX+side*5.5,z);
        let minCost=100000;
        for (const dz of [-1,0,1]) {
          const site=p(roadX+side*5.5,z+dz);
          const center=api.environmentSample(site);
          let lo=center.height,hi=center.height;
          for (const corner of [[-3,-3],[-3,3],[3,-3],[3,3]]) {
            const s=api.environmentSample([site[0]+corner[0],site[1]+corner[1]]);
            lo=Math.min(lo,s.height); hi=Math.max(hi,s.height);
          }
          const cost=hi-lo+center.slope*0.04+Math.abs(dz)*0.12;
          if (cost<minCost) { minCost=cost; chosen=site; }
        }
        const road=p(roadX,chosen[1]);
        const rh=api.environmentSample(road).height;
        const sh=api.environmentSample(chosen).height;
        const height=rh+Math.max(-0.35,Math.min(0.35,sh-rh));
        api.sculptTerrain({mode:"flatten",point:chosen,radius:4.6,strength:1,targetHeight:height});
        const door=[chosen[0]-side*3.25,chosen[1]];
        api.rampTerrain({start:road,end:door,width:1.7,startHeight:rh,endHeight:height,softness:0.55,strength:1});
        api.environmentSample(chosen);
        const group="home-"+homeIndex;
        const building=api.place({assetId:api.asset(house,homeIndex%3),position:chosen,facing:{target:road},groupId:group});
        api.foundation({name:"石屋基础",under:[building],shape:"rounded-rectangle",position:chosen,width:6.5,depth:6.4,top:"level",thickness:0.12,maxThickness:1.2,material:"stone"});
        api.route({id:"door-"+homeIndex,name:"入户短巷",points:[road,door],width:1.4,surface:"paving",material:"garden-stone",groupId:group});
        api.place({assetId:api.asset(props,homeIndex%2),position:[door[0]+side*0.15,door[1]+2.1],facing:{target:road},groupId:group});
        if (homeIndex%3===0) api.place({assetId:api.asset("street-lantern",0),position:[road[0]+side*1.95,road[1]-3.3],groupId:group});
        homeIndex++;
      }
    }
  }

  api.place({assetId:api.asset(hall,0),position:p(0,40),facing:{target:plaza},groupId:"civic"});
  api.route({id:"hall-entry",name:"会堂入口",points:[plaza,p(0,35.5)],width:4,surface:"paving",material:"garden-stone",groupId:"civic"});
  api.place({assetId:api.asset(fountain,0),position:p(-3,30),groupId:"civic"});
  for (const q of [[-6,34],[6,34],[6,29],[-6,26]]) {
    api.place({assetId:api.asset(bench,0),position:p(q[0],q[1]),facing:{target:plaza},groupId:"civic"});
  }
  for (const x of [-8,8]) {
    api.place({assetId:api.asset("street-lantern",0),position:p(x,33),groupId:"civic"});
    api.place({assetId:api.asset(tree,x<0?0:1),position:p(x,39),groupId:"civic"});
  }

  api.place({assetId:api.asset(market,0),position:p(0,-39),facing:{target:marketCourt},groupId:"market"});
  api.route({id:"market-entry",name:"集市通廊",points:[marketCourt,p(0,-36)],width:3.5,surface:"paving",material:"garden-stone",groupId:"market"});
  for (let i=0;i<4;i++) {
    api.place({assetId:api.asset(stall,i%2),position:p(-4.5+i*3,-39),facing:{target:p(-4.5+i*3,-31)},groupId:"market"});
  }
  for (const x of [-6,6]) {
    api.place({assetId:api.asset(bench,0),position:p(x,-31),facing:{target:marketCourt},groupId:"market"});
    api.place({assetId:api.asset("street-lantern",0),position:p(x,-34),groupId:"market"});
  }

  const wash=p(23,8);
  const wh=api.environmentSample(wash).height;
  api.sculptTerrain({mode:"flatten",point:wash,radius:4.5,strength:1,targetHeight:wh});
  smoothRoute([p(15,8),p(20,8),wash],2);
  api.environmentSample(wash);
  api.surface({id:"wash-court",surface:"paving",material:"garden-stone",region:{kind:"circle",center:wash,radius:3.8},clearNatural:true});
  api.route({id:"wash-lane",name:"洗衣坪支巷",points:[p(15,8),p(20,8),wash],width:2,surface:"paving",material:"garden-stone"});
  api.place({assetId:api.asset(trough,0),position:p(23,10),facing:{target:wash},groupId:"wash"});
  for (const x of [21,25]) api.place({assetId:api.asset(bench,0),position:p(x,6),facing:{target:wash},groupId:"wash"});
  api.place({assetId:api.asset(props,1),position:p(26,10),groupId:"wash"});

  for (const side of [-1,1]) {
    const edge=[p(side*26,-23),p(side*27,-7),p(side*28,18),p(side*25,32)];
    const bays=api.subdividePathBySpan({points:edge,span:3,fit:"stretch"});
    for (const bay of bays) {
      if (bay.center[1]>3 && bay.center[1]<13) continue;
      api.placeBetween({assetId:api.asset(wall,0),start:bay.start,end:bay.end,dimensions:[3,1.1,0.55],spanAxis:"x",groupId:"terrace-edges"});
    }
  }
  api.grass({id:"valley-meadow",preset:"meadow",region:{kind:"polygon",points:[[-47,-47],[47,-47],[47,47],[-47,47]]},density:0.55,variation:0.7,height:0.3,mix:{short:0.7,tall:0.25,flowers:0.05}});
  const naturalPoints=api.poissonDisk({bounds:{minX:-44,maxX:44,minZ:-44,maxZ:44},minDistance:5,maxPoints:150,seed:api.seed});
  let count=0;
  for (const point of naturalPoints) {
    const x=point[0],z=point[1];
    if (Math.abs(x-shift)<30) continue;
    const s=api.environmentSample([x,z]);
    const isRock=s.slope>32 || count%6===0;
    const key=isRock?rock:(s.height>7?pine:tree);
    api.place({assetId:api.asset(key,count%2),position:[x,z],rotationY:api.random(0,api.TAU),groupId:"surrounding-woodland"});
    count++;
  }
  api.spawn(p(0,-46),0);
  api.renderSuggestion("从南侧村口和东南高处观察山谷石屋村庄，表现石板街连续上升、屋顶错落与两处公共广场。建议柔和清晨侧光、山坡薄雾、自然石材质感；保留街巷中的可读阴影与暖色灯光，渲染设置另行确认。");
}
